item.title: Ayahuasca Origin
item.description: The origin of things. Hard to find when the beginning is something we don’t think it exists. Continuation, more like it. The one who passed the medicine is the same who tried to defend it. A loyal servant to Gaia. He was in charge to protect and make it available for humans and keep the legacy on. Soon to be forgotten. He’d later realize that humans not only are danger, but the ones who would get everything wrong.

item.title: Jungle
item.description: “Do you know why I chose the jungle?. I didn’t choose the jungle. The jungle is where I was born. A raw, hard and intense environment. Perfect place for a perfect accident. What could be more ideal? Beautiful and reluctant at the same time. A place that combines fire and mist, storm and sunsets. So much life, everywhere, every second, at your ears, at your shoulders, everywhere claiming what’s theirs.
